whatThisFileIs: An R1 authorship claim, and nothing else. It says who wrote the compliance-path files below and on which issue. It asserts nothing about whether they are correct, and it carries no `reviews[]` entry.
doesNotClaimR2: There is no `reviews[]` entry here and there will not be one from me. R2 wants a named reviewer who is not the author, and I am the author of every path above. This migration touches departments (board-shaped) and adds an app-writable table on the same surface that holds children's data, so under the team rule it goes to the CTO, and there is no independent security reviewer on this team (board declined the seat on cost) -- a CTO self-review is a recorded degradation, not independent review. The commit carrying these compliance-path files WILL report an R2 violation until that review records its verdict, and that violation is the honest state. The merge-in gate has already refused the unreviewed commit once (commit-msg hook); the compliance paths stay staged, uncommitted, until the CTO verdict lands. Writing a `reviews[]` entry naming myself would turn a control into a rubber stamp.
scopeOfTheClaim: R1 only: authorship of the listed paths on AFC-800. It is not clearance of the retention gate (plan 0.10.5), which only the CEO can clear. The same work also ships non-compliance paths that need no claim and commit separately: the three Nuxt routes under apps/web/server/api/departments/[id]/guides, apps/web/pages/departments/[id].vue (Guides tab), packages/shared/src/schemas/department.ts (guide zod schemas), and tests/web/department-guides.contract.mjs (16 assertions, green).
whatTheChangeActuallyDoes: AFC-800 (parent AFC-759): department guides. Migration 20261025_0043 creates department_guides (uuid PK; department NOT NULL REFERENCES departments(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT; title NOT NULL with a btrim CHECK; body NOT NULL DEFAULT ''; sort_order int NOT NULL DEFAULT 0; created_by uuid NULL; created_at/updated_at defaults) with fixed-name FK/CHECK/index, idempotent per the 0041 pattern, bootstrap-role guard per 0001/0041, no roles provisioned (ADR-0002). Grants: SELECT plus column-scoped INSERT (department, title, body, sort_order) and UPDATE (title, body, sort_order, updated_at) to directus_app; NO DELETE anywhere; PUBLIC revoked. The down script refuses with restrict_violation while any row exists, then revokes and drops conditionally (no CASCADE). Suite 43 covers shape, RESTRICT (23503), blank-title refusal (23514), the app ceiling (SELECT/INSERT/UPDATE allowed, DELETE/created_by/placement writes 42501), rerun idempotence, empty rollback plus forward re-apply, acceptance ordering (sort_order, id), and ends by dropping the table again so suite 85 can cycle departments through the 0020 down script (the RESTRICT FK would otherwise fail that drop; 85 owns departments). Numbering: 0043, no collision (0040/0041 precedent; 0044 is concurrent AFC-801 work on this branch, untouched here).
